01What does software development in Aligarh include?+

The scope can include workflow and product discovery, dashboards, portals and internal tools, roles, data and approval systems. We confirm the first useful release after reviewing the users, workflow and current tools.

02When is custom software worth building?+

It is useful when an important workflow creates repeated workarounds, errors or integration gaps that available products cannot solve economically.

03Does WeTakeFWD have to be physically based in Aligarh?+

No. We can deliver remotely for organisations in Aligarh. Any on-site work, service area or local presence is described accurately and agreed before the project begins.
